a.lede: Xandr has three weeks to appeal the record penalty.
a.title: Norway fined a Microsoft subsidiary $9.6 million for allegedly misusing Grindr user data

b.lede: Norway's Data Protection Authority (Datatilsynet) has fined Microsoft-owned advertising company Xandr NOK 92 million ($9.6M) for unlawfully processing and sharing sensitive data belonging to Grindr users in the country. [...]
b.title: Norway fines Microsoft ad firm $9.6 million over Grindr data sharing
